objective: Prove the two-class lemma (two classes of knots meeting every co-knotted pair once each have the same states) and check it explains OVERLAP-READ's 98 global swap-made bases: G1 each global hollow triple is a removed source knot, G2 the untouched class forces it.
status: Proved, refereed: two classes of knots with equal pair counts have the same NAE states as their union (checked on 272 six-regular one-pair weaves). Registered: G2 held (85 of 85), G1 failed on 7 of 98 global bases (extra global triples; 3 derived, 4 described by the referee).
title: What the global hollow triples are
